'''Mine rats''' were subterranean creatures from the [[Endor/Legends|Forest Moon of Endor]]. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], a pack of mine rats lived in the underground tunnels of the [[Death Watch bunker]].<ref name="SWG" />
